_meta.source: CLSU College of Veterinary Science and Medicine LEAP Review site, 'Syllabus' pages (sites.google.com/clsucvsm.edu.ph/leapreviews/syllabus/...). Topic names, in-subject weights and subtopic lists only; sample questions NOT copied.
_meta.caveat: This follows the OLDER 8-subject TOS (Medicine and Surgery combined at 18%; Zootechnics 14%, Microbiology 16%, Pathology 12%). The site itself says it is based on previous PRC guidelines. PRB Resolution No. 07 s.2024 (Enhanced TOS, Annex A) replaced it from Oct 2024 (9 subjects, Surgery separate). Use this as the topic backbone and reconcile with Annex A when obtained. A Surgery topic list is NOT included (no page found).
